node.title: Re: "Cannot find location"
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If this happens to be a Debian-based system, you could install the module via sudo apt-get install libdigest-md5-file-perl. Using [mod://local::lib], as you appear to have done, might be possible too, as long as you install the modules in a location that the webserver can access, i.e. not /root. We'd need to know more about your server set-up to give you better advice though.

If all this gets too complicated, then note that [mod://Digest::MD5::File] appears to be a convenience wrapper around the core module [doc://Digest::MD5], which you could use instead.
